## Result and owner

What changes, why it belongs here, and what is preserved?

## Source and disposition

Exact source versions and admission/migration/exclusion record. Does any source copy remain authoritative?

## Verification

Command/result, link/content checks, limitations. For behavioral work, link the owning implementation PR and real consumer evidence.

## Publication and retirement

Public-content review completed? Existing links preserved? Any merge/deployment/retirement still pending? No implicit capability expansion.
